question: Can the NLC-hosted 2024 article's citation to 《北京图书馆馆史资料汇编（二）：1949—1966》 pp.446—449 be bound to an exact physical volume and lawful direct-inspection/copy route without pretending that the cited pages have already been collated or that they identify catalog nos. 3482/3483?
answer: Yes at the bibliographic and access-route layer. The NLC-hosted 2024 study cites 《北京图书馆馆史资料汇编（二）：1949—1966》 pp.446—449 as a source in its Qu-family acquisition-history discussion. NDL Search closes the cited 1997 upper volume as an 866-page paper book, ISBN 7501314195, NDL call UL215-C3, bibliographic ID a0000036720, and explicitly lists the National Diet Library as holder. The same NDL record links a Tokyo Metropolitan Central Library paper holding, and the Tokyo first-party catalog closes the exact local copy as C/0161/1/2-1, material code 4000017284, Central stacks, usable, cooperative lending possible. Because pp.446—449 fall within the explicitly 866-page upper volume, the citation is now bound to the correct physical volume and two lawful Japanese holding routes. The project has not directly reviewed pp.446—449, so their wording, document identities, target-title mentions, and any purchase/donation assignment remain unresolved.
